Please enter valid values to see what the rule does.

%1$s gets through up to **%2$d× within %3$s**. If they call again in that period (call **#%4$d**), the call is rejected and they are blocked for **%5$s**. Always the calls of the **last %3$s** are counted. Calls during the block do not extend it.

%1$s gets through up to **%2$d× within %3$s**. If they call again in that period (call **#%4$d**), the call is silenced and they are blocked for **%5$s**. Always the calls of the **last %3$s** are counted. Calls during the block do not extend it.
All calls from %1$s are **always rejected** until you change the value or switch monitoring off.
All calls from %1$s are **always silenced** until you change the value or switch monitoring off.

The app counts the calls of a person in a **sliding window**: always the last X minutes, counted backwards from the current call.

**Example** with 2 allowed calls, 5 minutes, 3 hours block:

10:00 – 1 call → passes
10:03 – 2 calls → passes
10:09 – only this call counts (the others are older than 5 min) → passes
10:10 – 2 calls → passes
10:12 – 3 calls → **rejected, blocked until 13:12**
11:30 – blocked, call rejected, block stays until 13:12
13:15 – block over → passes

The call that exceeds the limit is already blocked. Calls during a block neither count nor extend it.

**0 allowed calls** means: always blocked.

Usually not needed: Android starts the screening service itself. Only if blocks are unreliable on your device, exclude the app from battery optimization.
FloodCallBlocker %1$s\nBlocks callers who call too often – temporarily. Fully offline, no internet permission. Free software under GPLv3.

Some people call again and again. You do not want to block them forever – just not every minute.\n\nFloodCallBlocker blocks a number automatically and temporarily when it calls too often. Everything stays on your phone.
So the app can check incoming calls, Android needs you to set it as your “Caller ID & spam app”. This is required. The app only looks at numbers you added.
While a number is blocked, a small notification shows until when – with a button to lift the block. Recommended, but blocks work without it.
Optional: with access to your contacts you can pick a contact (all its numbers count together), and the app keeps the numbers up to date. Without it you can still enter numbers by hand.
Shows a running block without sound.
Shows a running block briefly at the top of the screen, without sound.
